answer: Post a 70-credit bond and file one shale artifact: a crystal assay from a shale horizon, key-signed on a public board. Auditors replay each crystal assay against the horizon table for that layer; a reused serial or mismatched reading burns the bond. Filing costs 40 first, then 40+6(k-1) for the kth, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-artifact ring fails: one assay cannot serve two serials. Honest filers pay 40 once.
